In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], a '''Yuuzhan Vong individual''' was captured and brought to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility known as [[Cog Hive Seven]]. The [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s body an amalgamation of different [[Cybernetics/Legends|implants]], the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] quickly became the prison's newest reigning champion in the regular [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] matches that took place at the station. The [[Species/Legends|species]] were still unknown to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]],<ref name="Lock" /> and were referred to only as the Far Outsiders,<ref name="OF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> causing prison authorities to not find the [[Soldier/Legends|warrior's]] species in their databases. However, some of the guards believed that the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] was a [[Gender/Legends|female]]. Armed with an [[amphistaff]], the warrior won every match for six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] straight, until the Yuuzhan Vong was matched against new-arrival [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], who was on an undercover [[Mission to Cog Hive Seven|mission]] aboard Cog Hive Seven as the criminal "Jagannath." After a hard-fought battle, Maul [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Yuuzhan Vong in a brutal fashion, claiming the mantle of the prison's champion.<ref name="Lock" />
